decisions.authority: PC4 business calendars and shifts, PC1 locations, PC2 Parties, SO2 operational relationships, SO1 schedulable catalog targets and SO5 Resources
decisions.decision: Adopt the already-frozen authorities as references. SO10 creates no competing Party, customer, offering, resource, location or business-time identity.

decisions.authority: legacy branch/order timestamps, staff assignment snapshots and domain-specific service timing fields
decisions.decision: Map only prospectively when explicit evidence identifies a booking or service-execution meaning. Historical order and branch timestamps are not bulk-reinterpreted as reservations.

decisions.authority: domain-specific appointment, visit, reservation or service references
decisions.decision: Bridge through stable public source references into SO10 reservation/service-execution records without writing source-domain private state.

decisions.authority: Finance business dates, reconciliation calendars, sales/orders, legacy payment facts and existing operational timestamps
decisions.decision: Preserve historical bytes and source authority. PC4 resolves prospective SO10 business time; frozen Finance retains immutable historical financial time.

decisions.authority: future pack-specific appointment/reservation writers and ad hoc scheduling fields
decisions.decision: Retire only after packs, adapters and R6 cutover prove equivalent behavior. SO10 performs no destructive production conversion.
